case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for the transparent view of your wage costs. We value the long cooperation with your foundry and take your point on labour seriously.

We cannot move to your proposed price, but we have prepared options that give you a longer contract term and, in some cases, a later payment date in exchange for a firmer price:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.25; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-04-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 46.29; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-02-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-02-01.

Each option stands on its own, so please choose whichever suits your foundry best. We would be glad to settle this together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your constructive approach and the options provided, which reflect our long-standing partnership. Our family foundry has always valued the strong trust between our companies, and we remain dedicated to working together successfully.

We are willing to accept the 24-month contract term and the later effective date of 1 February 2027 to give you planning security. In return for these accommodations, we can offer a revised price of €51.50 per unit. For our overall Angebot, this means a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. 

Please note that this proposal remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our shared path.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your revised proposal and for accepting the longer contract term. We appreciate the constructive spirit and the planning security it gives you.

The price is still some way from where we can close, so we have adjusted our options. Each one keeps the longer term you are willing to accept, and the choice of start date and payment term is yours:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 47.10; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-02-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 46.77; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-04-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 47.39; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Option A answers your wish for a later start with a longer payment term, Option B has a later start with the payment term you proposed, and Option C starts earlier with a longer payment term. We would be glad to settle on one of them with you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear Mr Moser,

Thank you for your revised offer and for accepting the earlier start date. We appreciate the warm tone and the long relationship with your foundry.

We are still apart on price, so we have adjusted our options once more. Option A keeps the shorter payment term with a later start.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 48.53; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-04-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 48.71; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-01-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 48.72; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-02-01.

We are making a serious effort to close this and would be glad to settle it with you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We appreciate your serious effort to close this agreement and your further movement on price. Over the many years of working together, our family foundry has always valued the deep trust between our companies. 

Building on your Option B, we are prepared to make another concession and reduce our price to €50.20 per unit. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

Our offer stands at a price of €50.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and valid from 1 January 2027: €50.20 per unit. A contract term of 24 months also applies to this option.

We trust this step will allow us to finalize the agreement and continue our long-standing partnership. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
